title: Review producer result validation and ordinary abstention shapes

checks.name: typecheck_and_verify
checks.command: bun run typecheck && bun run verify
checks.reason: read-only preparation packet; no full-suite slot

findings.evidence: Existing validator tests use claims:[] only inside invalid envelopes (result.test.ts:31-52). Behavior of empty ok is implemented at result.ts:135-157 and already proven at schema.test.ts:24-27 and model.test.ts:73-84.
findings.required_action: P033/P036 may copy the draft rows into result.test.ts; do not add a second contract file.

findings.evidence: unknown_predicate is both a DroppedDraft on ok and a PRODUCER_REJECT_REASONS whole-call reason. Current producer emits only the drop. Doctor omits it from modelFailure (doctor.ts:184-192).
findings.invariant: per-draft drop is not a whole-call rejection
findings.required_action: Do not collapse the two wire shapes.

findings.evidence: ExtractMine maps every ok empty-claim result to empty and advances the cursor, including drop-only results counted in claims_rejected (write-pass.ts:88-93). Scorer abstention requires dropped count 0.
findings.invariant: dropped drafts cannot count as abstention; model failure is not emptiness
findings.required_action: Do not treat rail empty as proof of quality abstention.

findings.evidence: unsupported_metadata is rejected schema_invalid with diagnostic.rule unsupported_metadata and usage_known true. Ordinary envelope failure is usage_known false and diagnostic.rule bad_response.
findings.invariant: same reject reason does not imply the same diagnostic or usage_known
findings.required_action: Keep diagnostic.rule and usage_known as the distinguisher.

blockers: node_modules / @kizuki/core absent; packages/llm tests not executed
full typecheck and bun run verify not run

must_preserve: ok empty claims is successful-empty, not unavailable
dropped drafts are not scorer abstention
unsupported_metadata diagnostic is not envelope bad_response
downstream_handoff.integration_hint: If a patch lands, copy /work/out/bounded-neutral-parser.test.ts cases into packages/core/test/producer/result.test.ts. Do not duplicate schema/produce/scorer tests.

next_step: P033/P036 consume the golden table and, if they patch producer tests, copy the validator-seam empty-ok rows into packages/core/test/producer/result.test.ts without revising P034's corpus.
